dimensions.label: Agricultural output
dimensions.description: Harvest mass or normalized crop yield with crop, period, area basis and protocol.

dimensions.label: Crop quality
dimensions.description: Measured grade, size, sugar content, rejection rate or other crop-specific quality indicator.

dimensions.label: Water use
dimensions.description: Irrigation volume or water-use efficiency with area, season and control basis.

dimensions.label: Energy output
dimensions.description: Metered generation, specific yield or capacity factor for a stated interval.

dimensions.label: Farm economics
dimensions.description: Farmer revenue, operating cost, margin, lease income or payback under a defined accounting boundary.

dimensions.label: Dual land use
dimensions.description: Continued agricultural production alongside solar generation, preferably expressed as land-equivalent ratio or another defined utilization metric.

observations.label: Table-grape harvest beneath panels
observations.measurementScope: Reported total harvest from the vineyard beneath the solar panels
observations.method: Publicly reported harvested mass; the underlying measurement protocol was not published in the reviewed source.
observations.claimBoundary: This is total harvested mass only. It is not yield per dunam, a comparison with a control vineyard, or evidence that panels caused a yield increase.

observations.label: Renewable electricity generation observed
observations.measurementScope: Operating panels above the monitored vineyard
observations.method: Independent journalistic field report; no generation interval or meter data was published.
observations.claimBoundary: The source supports that electricity was being generated, not how much electricity or whether performance exceeded a benchmark.

observations.label: Concurrent crop harvest and solar operation
observations.measurementScope: Vineyard and overhead solar system at the same reviewed site
observations.method: Independent report of harvested grapes beneath electricity-generating panels.
observations.claimBoundary: This establishes simultaneous use, not a land-equivalent ratio or quantified land-use benefit.
